---
title: "NIMBioS"
---

Thousands of scientists have participated in our working groups, postdoctoral
positions, tutorials, webinars, and more. We have also been a fertile ground for
launching new initiatives, including the Center for the Dynamics of Social
Complexity ([DySoC](https://dysoc.utk.edu/)), the Center for Analysis and
Prediction of Pandemic Expansion ([APPEX](https://appex.org/)), and the
[Synergy Evaluation Institute](https://cehhs.utk.edu/synergy/) (formerly NISER).

We maintain robust facilities for scientific computing (including our cluster
[Rocky](/computing/), with 580 CPU and 4.5 TB RAM), and remote sensing. For more
about our activities and opportunities, please peruse our menus above. Welcome!
